text:
sarah: Heads-up — we're scheduling a targeted base-image rebuild to address a handful of active CVEs, trim unneeded packages, and rotate KMS keys for builder artifacts. Goal: minimal blast radius, full audit trail, and SBOMs attached. Target window: Fri EOD (PST).

ben: +1. Can you drop the shortlist of images and reasons?

sarah: Sure — short list:
```
- rwinf/python-base:3.9.12 -> pin 3.9.18 (openssl/CVE fixes)
- rwinf/ubuntu-min:20.04 -> 22.04-slim (kernel/packer CVEs)
- rwinf/gpu-runtime:1.2 -> 1.3 (remove unused kernel modules, lower attack surface)
```
Main drivers: openssl CVE, glibc improvements, and unnecessary suid/bin removal.

diego: For KMS — do we rotate the existing key or create a new CMK and grant decrypt to the build identities? Rotating in-place could break old encrypted artifacts.

ben: Strong recommend create new key, grant kms:Decrypt to a limited set of service accounts (build-runner-sa, image-pusher-sa) and condition on source VPC/subnet. Then update build pipeline to use the new key ARN.

elena: Audit/logging checklist: every build and push must emit a structured event to audit-log-prod and also to the S3 archive for compliance. Retention 365d. We'll need a forwarding config in fluentd or use the existing audit-forwarder.

sarah: jamal — can you add an RBAC change: allow build-runner-sa kms:Decrypt on the new key only, and deny decrypt from other roles? We want to avoid cluster-wide policies.

jamal: On it. I'll scope the IAM policy and open a PR. Plan: new key ARN, grant to build-runner-sa, add source IP/VPC condition, no wildcard principals.

buildbot: Security scan: CVE-2026-1234 (openssl) matches ubuntu-min:20.04 layer — severity: high.

sarah: Ok — that's urgency. Diego, will the runtime KV cache survive the rebase or do we need to flush?

diego: KV cache format is compatible. However, libc/openssl changes may affect symbol-resolution in a tiny fraction of models. We'll run a canary pool of 2 GPU nodes with the new image and run full regression set. If any model shows >3% latency regression or 5xx spike, abort and roll back.

elena: Add automated monitor: watch 5xx rate, 95th token latency, and error-rate on /generate. If thresholds breach, auto-rollback and page oncall. I'll add the alert rule to alertmanager and a runbook entry.

sarah: Good. Also ensure SBOM (CycloneDX) is generated for each rebuilt image and attached as image metadata. Security/compliance will need it for audits.

diego: SBOM is part of the build pipeline. I'll ensure cyclonedx tar is uploaded to artifact-store and the image manifest includes sbom_url.

ben: I opened infra PR with CMK creation and KMS policy: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1024 — includes logs to CloudTrail and KMS key rotation window.

jamal: RBAC PR opened for build-runner-sa and image-pusher-sa scoping: https://github.com/redwood/iam/pull/213 — adds condition for sourceVPC and time-limited grant. ETA review: 3h.

sarah: Action items recap:
- jamal: finalize RBAC PR and add condition (kms:Decrypt scoped)
- ben: merge CMK infra PR and ensure CloudTrail for key events
- diego: run canary (2 nodes), run regression tests, attach SBOMs
- elena: wire audit-forwarder or fluentd patch to send build events to audit-log-prod with 365d retention and add alert rules for regressions

sarah: We'll reconvene at 15:30 PST here. If canary fails, rollback policy: revert image tag to previous, revoke new key if it's already in use, and file incident with timeline and postmortem.

diego: Noted. I'll post canary logs and performance diffs here.

elena: If rollback happens, ensure fluentd doesn't drop pre-rotation logs — we should preserve them for triage.

ben: Also verifying container hardening checklist: dropcapabilities = ["ALL"], add nonroot user, remove package manager in final image, enable read-only rootfs. Will add to Dockerfiles.

jamal: PRs linked above. I'll ping infra and sec-reviews.

sarah: Thanks all. @here please don't push unrelated infra changes into the build pipeline during the window. Update this thread with PR merges and canary results.

sarah: Closing initial thread — will reopen with canary status.
